summary: American Express filed an 8-K announcing a proposed public offering of depositary shares representing 1/1,000th interests in new Fixed Rate Reset Noncumulative Preferred Shares, Series E. Net proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes, including partially or fully redeeming outstanding 3.550% Fixed Rate Reset Noncumulative Preferred Shares, Series D. Pricing and redemption remain subject to market conditions, with no assurance of closing. A preliminary prospectus supplement was filed August 5, 2026. This is an issuer capital-management action: a preferred-stock offering paired with a potential redemption, functioning as a refinancing. Watch for pricing terms and whether the Series D redemption occurs.
